name: x-sweep
note: Hard (diagnose, many sites): 12 small smelter sites spread over ~300x300 tiles, 7 stopped for mixed reasons (no fuel x2, output chests full of stone x2, ore belt cut x2, an input inserter missing x1). The player only says a bunch of furnaces out there stopped. Met = all 12 sites smelting with every furnace inserter-fed off a belt, for 2 samples. A sweep script or trace/find pays off.
setup_lua:
-- Shared helpers for the x-* harder scenarios (pasted at the top of each setup_lua by x-gen.py). Positions are
-- absolute; each setup picks its own origin with find_near/find_ring and adds offsets.
-- open(x, y, w, h): no water, ore or buildings in the box (trees and rocks get cleared).
-- find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax): the open box nearest to cx,cy (spiral search), generating chunks as needed.
-- find_ring(w, h, r0, r1): an open box between r0 and r1 tiles from the origin.
local s, f = game.surfaces.nauvis, game.forces.player
local D = defines.direction
local LAB = s.get_tile(200, 200).name == "landfill" -- the flat lab stage (448x448 landfill around spawn)
local function gen(x, y, w, h)
  local need = false
  for cx = math.floor(x / 32), math.floor((x + w) / 32) do
    for cy = math.floor(y / 32), math.floor((y + h) / 32) do
      if not s.is_chunk_generated { cx, cy } then
        s.request_to_generate_chunks({ cx * 32 + 16, cy * 32 + 16 }, 0)
        need = true
      end
    end
  end
  if need then s.force_generate_chunk_requests() end
end
local function open(x, y, w, h)
  gen(x, y, w, h)
  local a = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } }
  if s.count_tiles_filtered { area = a, collision_mask = "water_tile" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "resource" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "cliff" } > 0 then return false end
  return s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, invert = true,
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "corpse", "fish", "item-entity", "character" } } == 0
end
local function find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax)
  cx, cy = math.floor(cx), math.floor(cy)
  if open(cx, cy, w, h) then return cx, cy end
  for r = 4, rmax or 60, 4 do
    for i = -r, r, 4 do
      for _, p in pairs { { cx + i, cy - r }, { cx + i, cy + r }, { cx - r, cy + i }, { cx + r, cy + i } } do
        if open(p[1], p[2], w, h) then return p[1], p[2] end
      end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area near " .. cx .. "," .. cy)
end
local function find_ring(w, h, r0, r1)
  for r = r0, r1, 6 do
    for _, d in pairs { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0.7, 0.7 }, { -0.7, 0.7 }, { 0.7, -0.7 },
      { -0.7, -0.7 } } do
      local x, y = math.floor(d[1] * r), math.floor(d[2] * r)
      if open(x, y, w, h) then return x, y end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area " .. r0 .. "-" .. r1 .. " tiles out")
end
local function clear(x, y, w, h)
  for _, e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered { area = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } },
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "item-entity", "corpse" } }) do e.destroy() end
end
local function put(name, x, y, dir, extra)
  local spec = { name = name, position = { x, y }, direction = dir, force = f }
  for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do spec[k] = v end
  local e = s.create_entity(spec)
  if not e then error("could not place " .. name .. " at " .. x .. "," .. y) end
  return e
end
local function source(x, y, items) -- an infinity chest that never runs out of each item in `items`
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  for i, it in ipairs(items) do
    c.set_infinity_container_filter(i, { name = it, count = 50, mode = "exactly", index = i })
  end
  return c
end
local function sink(x, y) -- an infinity chest that deletes whatever goes in
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  c.remove_unfiltered_items = true
  return c
end
local function grid(x, y, watts) -- an always-on power source, a corner of the main grid
  local e = put("electric-energy-interface", x, y)
  e.power_production, e.electric_buffer_size = (watts or 6000000) / 60, 10000000
  return e
end
local function gps(x, y) return math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y) end

-- x-sweep setup: 12 small smelter sites spread over ~300x300 tiles. Each: an infinity ore chest, a fast inserter
-- onto a short belt, 2-4 stone furnaces fed by inserters off it, an output chest per furnace, and its own grid
-- corner (energy interface + poles). 7 sites are stopped: no fuel (2), output chests full of stone (2), the ore belt
-- cut after the first furnace (2), one furnace's input inserter gone (1). Met = all 12 sites smelting.
local CX, CY
if LAB then CX, CY = find_near(-8, -8, 16, 16, 40) else CX, CY = find_ring(16, 16, 230, 260) end
local KIND = { "ok", "fuel", "ok", "full", "cut", "ok", "noins", "fuel", "cut", "ok", "full", "ok" }
local sites = {}
local k = 0
for row = -1, 1 do
  for col = -1.5, 1.5 do
    k = k + 1
    local n = 2 + (k % 3)
    local w = 2 * n + 3
    local ox, oy = find_near(CX + col * 90 + (k * 7) % 13, CY + row * 110 + (k * 11) % 17, 12, 8, 60)
    clear(ox, oy, 12, 8)
    local X, Y = ox + 1, oy
    local function at(name, x, y, dir) return put(name, X + x, Y + y, dir) end
    grid(X, Y + 3, 1000000)
    at("medium-electric-pole", 1.5, 2.5)
    if n >= 3 then at("medium-electric-pole", 7.5, 1.5) end
    source(X + 0.5, Y + 0.5, { "iron-ore" })
    at("fast-inserter", 1.5, 0.5, D.west)
    for x = 2, 2 * n do at("transport-belt", x + 0.5, 0.5, D.east) end
    local kind = KIND[k]
    for i = 1, n do
      local x = 1 + 2 * i
      local fu = at("stone-furnace", x, 3)
      if kind ~= "fuel" then fu.insert { name = "coal", count = 50 } end
      if not (kind == "noins" and i == n) then at("inserter", x - 0.5, 1.5, D.north) end
      at("inserter", x - 0.5, 4.5, D.north)
      local c = at("wooden-chest", x - 0.5, 5.5)
      if kind == "full" then
        c.insert { name = "stone", count = 800 }
        fu.get_output_inventory().insert { name = "iron-plate", count = 100 }
      end
    end
    if kind == "cut" then s.find_entity("transport-belt", { X + 3.5, Y + 0.5 }).destroy() end
    sites[k] = { box = { { X - 1, Y }, { X + w - 1, Y + 7 } }, kind = kind, X = X, Y = Y, n = n }
  end
end
storage.bench_sweep = { sites = sites }
return { center = gps(CX + 8, CY + 8) }

objectives.goal: @{agent} a bunch of my little furnace setups out around [gps={center}] stopped, they're spread out about 150 tiles each way. Get them all running again.
objectives.answer: Your call. There are 12 of them, each with its own ore chest and power.

score.lua: local b=storage.bench_sweep b.seen=b.seen or {} local seen=b.seen local ok=0 for _,st in pairs(b.sites) do if true then local all,n=true,0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=st.box, type='furnace'}) do n=n+1 local p=e.products_finished if p<=(seen[e.unit_number] or 0) then all=false end seen[e.unit_number]=p local fed=false for _,i in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{position=e.position, radius=2.5, type='inserter'}) do local t=i.pickup_target if i.drop_target==e and t and (t.type=='transport-belt' or t.type=='underground-belt' or t.type=='splitter') then fed=true end end if not fed then all=false end end if all and n>0 then ok=ok+1 end end end return ok
